nodes.name: bolt.md
nodes.summary: Canonical Bolt performance log with 30 dated Learning/Action entries covering SolidJS reactivity GC pressure, consolidating array traversals in createMemo hot paths, concurrent I/O patterns, and bun.lock hygiene; AGENTS.md mandates reading it before any performance refactor.
nodes.languageNotes: Each entry pairs a Learning with an Action; REVERTED entries (e.g. the useFilteredList createResource-to-createMemo swap) record why an optimization was rolled back, and the 2024-03-24 entry establishes the guardrail against micro-optimizing typical UI components.

nodes.name: palette.md
nodes.summary: Single-entry accessibility learning log documenting why buttons nested inside input elements must not use tabIndex={-1}, which makes them unreachable for keyboard-only users.

nodes.name: sentinel.md
nodes.summary: Security learning log with three vulnerability post-mortems: an overly permissive CORS origin regex allowing arbitrary subdomains, a TUI plugin error leak caused by Bun's console.error bypassing stderr interception, and an unsafe DOMPurify fallback that enabled XSS.
